house.description: Statute of limitations for minor sex abuse claims applied retroactively.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Judiciary Finance and Civil Law

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to civil actions; applying statute of limitations for minor sex abuse claims retroactively; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 541.073, subdivision 3.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 541.073, subdivision 3, is amended to read:

Subd. 3.
Applicability[+; retroactive application+].
[+(a) +]This section applies to an action for damages commenced against a person who was a cause of the plaintiff's damages either by (1) committing sexual abuse against the plaintiff, or (2) negligence.

[+(b) Notwithstanding any other provision of law, if the plaintiff was under the age of 18 at the time of the alleged abuse, this section applies to actions pending or commenced on or after August 1, 2025, including actions that were time-barred prior to August 1, 2025. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to civil actions; applying statute of limitations for minor sex abuse claims retroactively; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 541.073, subdivision 3.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 541.073, subdivision 3, is amended to read:

Subd. 3.
Applicability; retroactive application.
(a) This section applies to an action for damages commenced against a person who was a cause of the plaintiff's damages either by (1) committing sexual abuse against the plaintiff, or (2) negligence.

(b) Notwithstanding any other provision of law, if the plaintiff was under the age of 18 at the time of the alleged abuse, this section applies to actions pending or commenced on or after August 1, 2025, including actions that were time-barred prior to August 1, 2025.
additions: (b) Notwithstanding any other provision of law, if the plaintiff was under the age of 18 at the time of the alleged abuse, this section applies to actions pending or commenced on or after August 1, 2025, including actions that were time-barred prior to August 1, 2025.
